name: Ember Lane
business_idea: a casual Southeast Asian charcoal-grill restaurant in a city laneway, serving satay, grilled fish and shared plates late into the evening
audience: 25–45 year-old city diners and friend groups looking for a lively, affordable night out

ideas.title: Hearth Heritage
ideas.summary: A vintage hawker-stall badge that says 'we've been grilling like this for generations'.
ideas.rationale: Leans into authenticity and craft — the strongest trust signal for a grill restaurant; badge works on signage, aprons and stamps.
ideas.style_descriptor: heritage craft aesthetic, vintage hawker-stall badge influences, classic serif lettering, warm muted inks, subtle letterpress texture, established and trustworthy

typography.feel: a classic high-contrast serif in capitals, slightly condensed, arched along the badge

logo.description: a round badge with the name "Ember Lane" arched across the top, a small grill with three rising flame curls in the centre, and two short horizontal rules either side
logo.colors: deep oxblood red on warm rice-paper cream, with a thin antique brass inner ring

story.headline: Three generations of fire
story.narrative: From a grandfather's pushcart grill to a laneway restaurant — the same charcoal, the same recipes.
scenes: an old pushcart satay grill on a 1960s street at dusk, smoke curling up
hands fanning glowing charcoal under rows of satay skewers
a lively modern laneway restaurant at night with friends sharing plates under string lights
story.layout: three connected vignettes flowing left to right like a vintage storybook print

card.front: the badge logo centred on a solid deep oxblood background, printed in warm cream
card.back: warm rice-paper cream with a thin brass border and small placeholder contact lines bottom left
card.material: thick cotton letterpress card stock with visible deboss
card.scene: on a dark wooden table beside a small bowl of peanut sauce

ideas.imagery: warm tungsten-lit documentary photography, smoke and charcoal glow, film grain

ai_review.comment: EXAMPLE ONLY — replace after reviewing the real renders. Strongest category fit and story; badge detail will blur below ~24px.

ideas.title: Modern Ember
ideas.summary: A crisp geometric mark where a laneway's perspective lines become a flame.
ideas.rationale: Clean and contemporary — stands out from the heritage-heavy category and scales perfectly to app icons and delivery bags.
ideas.style_descriptor: modern geometric design, clean constructed shapes, balanced proportions, confident flat colour, crisp and contemporary
ideas.tagline: Fire at the end of the lane

typography.feel: a geometric sans-serif, medium weight, generous letter spacing

logo.description: two converging straight lines forming a lane in perspective, whose vanishing point becomes a simple geometric flame, placed left of the wordmark "Ember Lane"
logo.colors: near-black coal grey with the flame in bright ember orange

story.headline: Follow the glow
story.narrative: Down a quiet lane, one warm light — follow it to the grill.
scenes: a quiet city laneway at night seen in strong perspective
an orange glow and smoke at the far end of the lane
a sleek open grill counter with chefs and diners lit in ember orange
story.layout: three panels with the lane's perspective lines running continuously through all of them

card.front: the symbol alone in bright ember orange on solid near-black coal
card.back: soft ash white with the full logo top left and placeholder contact lines below, generous white space
card.material: smooth heavy matte card with an ember-orange painted edge
card.scene: on a concrete surface with hard directional light

ideas.imagery: high-contrast night photography, ember highlights, clean architectural lines

ideas.title: Night Market Joy
ideas.summary: A playful, hand-lettered street-food brand full of colour and noise.
ideas.rationale: Captures the fun, shared, late-night energy — best for social media and a younger crowd.
ideas.style_descriptor: playful friendly street-food design, rounded chunky hand-lettering, bouncy energetic composition, bright cheerful flat colours, approachable and warm

typography.feel: rounded chunky hand-lettered letters with a slight bounce

logo.type: wordmark with a small character accent
logo.description: a bouncy rounded hand-lettered wordmark "Ember Lane" with a smiling satay skewer replacing the letter L
logo.colors: bright chili red letters with a turmeric yellow skewer

story.headline: Grab a stick, grab a seat
story.narrative: Smoke, chatter and too many skewers — the night market feeling, every night.
scenes: friends arriving at a busy colourful laneway at night
a table piled with satay, grilled fish and drinks, hands reaching in
the group laughing together under strings of lanterns
story.layout: a lively comic-strip of three rounded panels

card.front: the wordmark on bright turmeric yellow
card.back: creamy coconut white with a scattered pattern of tiny skewers and placeholder contact lines
card.material: bright uncoated card with rounded corners
card.scene: on a colourful plastic stool top with a satay stick beside it

ideas.imagery: flash-lit candid photography of friends and food, saturated colour

ideas.title: Quiet Coals
ideas.summary: A restrained, premium identity built on a single brush stroke of glowing coal.
ideas.rationale: Positions Ember Lane as a chef-led destination — supports higher prices and a date-night audience.
ideas.style_descriptor: Japanese-inspired minimalism, quiet balance, asymmetric composition, ample negative space, natural muted tones, a single confident brush stroke

typography.feel: a light elegant serif in small capitals with wide spacing

logo.description: a single round ink brush stroke forming an open circle with one small persimmon-orange dot inside like a glowing coal, above the wordmark "Ember Lane"
logo.colors: sumi ink black with one persimmon orange dot

story.headline: Slow fire
story.narrative: One fire, tended all evening. Nothing rushed.
scenes: a single glowing coal close up in darkness
a chef's hands placing a skewer over the charcoal with care
a calm, softly lit dining counter with two guests
story.layout: an asymmetric composition with one large vignette and two small ones, lots of empty space

card.front: the brush-stroke symbol only, small and off-centre on soft washi white
card.back: sumi ink black with the wordmark and placeholder contact lines in light grey
card.material: textured handmade washi-style paper with deckled edges
card.scene: on a pale stone surface beside a small ceramic dish

ideas.imagery: low-key moody photography, single light source, dark backgrounds, steam and smoke

ideas.title: Lane Lights 70s
ideas.summary: A sunny retro identity of rounded stripes and soft-serif lettering, like a vintage beach-road diner sign.
ideas.rationale: Nostalgic and photogenic — a strong Instagram identity that differs from every grill competitor.
ideas.style_descriptor: retro 1970s graphic style, warm sunset colours, groovy soft-serif lettering, rounded stripes and arches, sunny nostalgic optimism

typography.feel: a chunky soft retro serif with rounded terminals

logo.description: the wordmark "Ember Lane" in a chunky soft retro serif, sitting under a half-sun arch made of three rounded stripes
logo.colors: deep cocoa brown lettering with burnt orange, mustard and cream stripes

story.headline: Golden hour, every hour
story.narrative: Sunset colours, sizzling grills and a soundtrack of old records.
scenes: a sunset over city rooftops in bands of orange and mustard
a retro diner-style grill with skewers sizzling
friends at a laneway table under a warm glowing arch sign
story.layout: three arched panels side by side like retro windows

card.front: the full logo on warm vintage cream
card.back: three rounded horizontal stripes in burnt orange, mustard and cocoa with placeholder contact lines on the cream band
card.material: thick matte card with rounded corners
card.scene: on a vintage formica table with a retro glass bottle

ideas.imagery: warm film-tone photography with grain and sun flare
